metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the book taken as far as the door, Tilney's pen, and the seven shillings on his table.

yesterday: He struck two oaths, By my holidame and God's me. By Jove stays, because he put it there.
Navarre is only the name. He signed the last leaf.
Seven shillings, company coin, counted at the priory. Edith's eight shillings is still owing till Lady Day.
Tomorrow you play Two Gents at two. The reckoning is after. The letter is still on the table.
